name: Platform
lead: One workspace across quotes, policies, claims, underwriting, CRM, FNOL and reporting — built around a shared policy record rather than stitched from separate systems.
architecture: The platform is not an integration of separate tools. Every screen — a quote, a bound policy, a claim, an underwriting file — reads and writes the same policy record, so the numbers reconcile because they were never separate to begin with.

Underneath sits a bi-temporal policy ledger and double-entry premium accounting. Corrections are new rows, not overwrites. The book balances by construction rather than by an overnight reconciliation job.
The service layer is Rust. The type system does real work in a system that has to reconcile — a written, earned, ceded or collected figure that has no matching contra entry does not compile.
